add_arcs.name: Blood Debt
add_arcs.desc: A life was saved years ago; the price is finally called in.

add_arcs.name: The Hunter's Warrant
add_arcs.desc: An authorised monster hunt becomes an investigation into who wrote the order.

add_arcs.name: The Last Invitation
add_arcs.desc: A formal invitation offers safety for one night and allegiance for much longer.

add_arcs.name: Daybreak Siege
add_arcs.desc: Hunters and the hunted race the sunrise while a safe house collapses around them.

add_arcs.name: Coffin Protocol
add_arcs.desc: A sealed sleeper wakes aboard a system that has forgotten why the lock existed.

add_arcs.name: The False Heartbeat
add_arcs.desc: Evidence says the victim is dead; every witness remembers speaking to them afterward.

add_arcs.name: Midnight Encore
add_arcs.desc: A performer with an impossible career must decide whether the audience deserves the truth.

add_arcs.name: The Familiar Chooses
add_arcs.desc: The smallest member of the group refuses its master and follows someone else.

add_arcs.name: Crimson Truce
add_arcs.desc: Two ancient enemies agree to one night of peace because something worse has arrived.

add_arcs.name: The Black March
add_arcs.desc: The army knows the road is lost and marches anyway because civilians are still behind it.

add_arcs.name: The Price of Victory
add_arcs.desc: Winning solves the immediate battle and destroys something the heroes meant to protect.

add_arcs.name: Demon at the Gate
add_arcs.desc: The monster outside the walls knows the defenders by name and claims it was invited.

add_arcs.name: Kingdom of Ash
add_arcs.desc: A ruined kingdom still has laws, heirs and citizens who refuse to call it dead.

add_arcs.name: Chaos Beyond the Stars
add_arcs.desc: The expedition finds a force in deep space that behaves like a curse rather than a phenomenon.

add_arcs.name: The Broken Saint
add_arcs.desc: A revered protector admits their miracle has always demanded a hidden sacrifice.

add_arcs.name: The Last Good Meal
add_arcs.desc: In the middle of catastrophe, the group spends scarce ingredients on one unnecessary feast.

add_arcs.name: The Pit Without Cheers
add_arcs.desc: A celebrated contest continues after the crowd realises the competitors cannot safely leave.

add_arcs.name: The Iron Witness
add_arcs.desc: A damaged machine remembers the atrocity differently from every surviving human.

add_arcs.name: Night of Two Monsters
add_arcs.desc: Predator and demon recognise each other first, forcing everyone else to choose which terror to trust.

add_arcs.name: No Clean Hands
add_arcs.desc: Every faction has committed something unforgivable; the final alliance begins with admitting it.
